conn.description: Connection this message concerns. Hosts route on it without decoding `p`.

Request.description: A request; the peer must answer with a response carrying the same `id`.

Empty.description: Params or result of a method that carries none.

min.description: Lowest protocol version the host speaks, for example `0.1.0`.

max.description: Highest protocol version the host speaks, for example `0.1.x`.

protocol.description: The protocol version chosen for this session.

JsonSchemaDoc.description: A JSON Schema document. Opaque to the protocol (plugin protocol spec §13.2).

bundle.description: Path to the bundle, or a blob reference for an Orbital.

protocol.description: Semver range of supported protocol versions, for example `^0.1`.

permissions.description: Declared, but not yet enforced (plugin protocol spec §13.5).

devices.description: Devices the plugin drives through the core (§7.1).

directNetwork.description: Opens network sockets itself: its traffic isn't in the inspector (§7).

ui.description: Field order, groups, help, conditional visibility.

idempotent.description: Safe to retry with the same call ID.

learn.description: Supports "learn current values" for its params.

effect.description: `device` (the default) changes the world outside Covalence; simulate mode suppresses it. `internal` only changes Covalence itself.

name.description: A glob over the product or MIDI port name.

DeviceMatch.description: A manifest's `devices` entry: which devices the plugin drives.

Bytes.description: Raw bytes: `bin` in MessagePack, an array of byte values in JSON.

reconnect.description: Reopen after the far end closes or the device returns.

target.description: `host:port` for `tcp`; a device ID (§7.1) for `serial`, `hid` and `midi`.

IoWrite.description: `io.write` params (host → core, ntf). For `hid`, an output report whose first byte is the report ID.

ts.description: (M7) When the core read it: milliseconds since the Unix epoch, on the core's clock.

IoData.description: `io.data` params (core → host, ntf). For `hid`, an input report.

reportId.description: `get`: which report, and how many bytes to read.

IoState.description:
`io.state` params (core → host, ntf). A device handle closes with
`error: "unplugged"`, and opens again when the same device returns.

id.description: Stable: from kind, vendor, product and serial number where there is one, else the port path.

path.description: OS path or port name, for display.

DeviceList.description: `device.list` params (host → core, req): devices this plugin's `devices` match. Result: `DeviceInfoList`.

permissions.description: Resolved from the manifest templates and the config. Not yet enforced (plugin protocol spec §13.5).

PathSegment.description: A path segment: a key, or an integer collection key.

StateSnapshot.description: `state.snapshot` params (ntf). Replaces the connection's whole subtree.

call.description:
The `action.invoke` call that produced this change, if any. Unset for
changes from device traffic outside an action.

at.description: The node the event happened at, relative to the connection root (`["outputs", 3]`). Absent, it's the root.

call.description: The `action.invoke` call that produced this event, if any.

Log.description: `log` params (ntf). The envelope's `conn` is optional here.

call.description: ULID. Idempotency key; matches the journal's `action.requested.call`.

term.description: Fencing term. The host rejects any term lower than the highest it has seen.

deadline.description: Milliseconds. The host gives up after this long.

Placement.description: Where a control is, in grid cells.

value.description: Velocity for `down`, detents for `turn`, 0 to 1 (or `[x, y]`) for `value`, 1 or 0 for `touch`.

ts.description: The host's timestamp, in milliseconds on its own clock.

ImageFormat.description: (M7) `rgb`: raw 8-bit RGB, rows top to bottom, for devices whose driver packs images itself.

SurfaceLevel.description: `surface.level` params (core → host, ntf), for `level` outputs: motor faders, encoder rings, meters.
